title: Evaluation Metrics and Judges
summary: This module provides various evaluators for assessing model outputs, including LLM-based judges, content containment checks, and statistical evaluators for report generation.

nodes.label: LLM Judge
nodes.title: LLM Judge
nodes.description: Evaluates model outputs against a rubric using a language model, providing a score and an assertion of pass/fail.

nodes.label: Contains Evaluator
nodes.title: Contains Evaluator
nodes.description: Checks if the model's output contains a specified value, supporting various data types and case sensitivity.

nodes.label: ROC AUC Evaluator
nodes.title: ROC AUC Evaluator
nodes.description: Computes the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve and Area Under the Curve (AUC) for binary classification tasks from case data.

nodes.label: Precision-Recall Evaluator
nodes.title: Precision-Recall Evaluator
nodes.description: Calculates and plots the Precision-Recall curve and its AUC, useful for evaluating binary classifiers, especially with imbalanced datasets.

nodes.label: Kolmogorov-Smirnov Evaluator
nodes.title: Kolmogorov-Smirnov Evaluator
nodes.description: Generates a Kolmogorov-Smirnov plot and statistic, comparing the cumulative distribution functions of scores for positive and negative cases.

nodes.label: Evaluator Context
nodes.title: Evaluator Context
nodes.description: Provides the necessary input, output, and expected output data for evaluators to perform their assessment.

nodes.label: Report Evaluator Context
nodes.title: Report Evaluator Context
nodes.description: Supplies report-specific data, including cases and evaluation results, to evaluators that generate analytical reports.

nodes.label: Model Integration
nodes.title: Model Integration
nodes.description: Handles interactions with various language models, providing a unified interface for model calls.

nodes.label: Dataset Management
nodes.title: Dataset Management
nodes.description: Manages the creation and handling of evaluation datasets, providing structured inputs for evaluators.

groups.label: Common Evaluators
groups.title: Common Evaluators
groups.description: General-purpose evaluators for direct assessment of model outputs.

groups.label: Report Evaluators
groups.title: Report Evaluators
groups.description: Evaluators designed to generate statistical reports and plots from aggregated evaluation data.

groups.label: Evaluation Contexts
groups.title: Evaluation Contexts
groups.description: Data structures that provide the necessary information for evaluators to perform their tasks.
